intuition: Bit operations update one logical position, while a global flip flag avoids touching every stored bit.

brute_force.approach: Store a string or list of bits and rewrite every bit on flip.
brute_force.time: fix/unfix O(1), flip O(n), all/one/count O(n)

optimal.approach: Keep underlying bits, a lazy inversion flag, and the current count of logical ones.

edge_cases: Repeated fix or unfix calls leave the count unchanged.
After flip, logical values are the stored bits XOR the inversion flag.
